title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 106 ]

blocks.text: For their own benefit, companies have various ways of offering lower prices. One way of doing this is a trade discount. It is offered to the shops or business that buy goods on a large scale and sell them. There is also a quantity discount, which is offered to individuals who order large quantities of a product. The company gives a price break to these buyers because they help cut the costs of selling, storing, shipping, and billing. Finally, a cash discount is a lower price offered to people who pay in cash.

readingSentences.english: For their own benefit, companies have various ways of offering lower prices.
readingSentences.korean: 회사들은 이익을 내기 위하여 다양한 방법으로 가격을 낮추고 있다.

readingSentences.english: One way of doing this is a trade discount.
It is offered to the shops or business that buy goods on a large scale and sell them.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 대규모로 상품을 구입하고 판매하는 상점이나 사업체에 제공한다.

readingSentences.english: There is also a quantity discount, which is offered to individuals who order large quantities of a product.
readingSentences.korean: 양적 할인도 있는데 그것은 다량으로 물건을 구매할 때에 개인에게 제공된다.

readingSentences.english: The company gives a price break to these buyers because they help cut the costs of selling, storing, shipping, and billing.
readingSentences.korean: 회사들이 가격 할인을 이런 구매자들에게 제공하는 이유는 그들이 판매, 보관, 선적, 청구서 작성 등의 비용을 줄일 수 있기 때문이다.

readingSentences.english: Finally, a cash discount is a lower price offered to people who pay in cash.
readingSentences.korean: 마지막으로 현금 할인이란 구매하는 사람들에게 저렴한 가격으로 제공되는 것이다.
